text.p: These are the leading stories in the Mauritius press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- South Africa's Nedbank could take 20 percent stake in State Bank of Mauritius, Mauritian bourse's second largest firm by market capitalisation with share capital worth 4.85 billion rupees ($224.84 million).
- Mauritian businessmen and industrialists interested in investing in sugar mill Sirama and oil refinery Solima based in Madagascar.
- South Africa's judicial authority has reopened inquiry into crash of SAA Boeing 747 Helderberg on November 28, 1987, off Mauritius' northeast coast in which 159 people were killed.
- Unionised sugar industry workers claiming 30 percent salary increase in memorandum to Mauritius Sugar Planters Association.
